cmd:
flock -w 60 /tmp/vps_git.lock -c 'echo === git status --short ===; git -C /opt/weather-pipeline/repo status --short; echo === git diff --name-status (unstaged) ===; git -C /opt/weather-pipeline/repo diff --name-status; echo === git diff --stat (unstaged) ===; git -C /opt/weather-pipeline/repo diff --stat; echo === git diff --cached --name-status (staged, if any) ===; git -C /opt/weather-pipeline/repo diff --cached --name-status; echo === rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD (still ahead?) ===; git -C /opt/weather-pipeline/repo rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD; echo === mtimes of changed tracked files ===; git -C /opt/weather-pipeline/repo status --short | awk "{print \$2}" | while read f; do stat -c "%Y  %y  %n" "/opt/weather-pipeline/repo/$f" 2>/dev/null; done; echo === current time for reference ===; date -u +%s; date -u
'
